info.name: OrgResource Course A — Image HTTP acceptance
info.description: Executable, fictional-data Postman/Newman acceptance for Resource create, multipart PNG upload, byte retrieval and safe zero-stock cleanup. The current 26 routes remain covered by the O1/O3/O4-O5/O14 execution collections. Import this alongside the current 28-route reference; set imageFile to the included synthetic fixture path.

item.name: Create isolated fictional Resource for image tests

exec: pm.test('Resource created with HTTP 201', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(201); });

if (pm.response.code === 201) { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.test('Created Resource has a positive ID', function () { pm.expect(body.id).to.be.above(0); }); pm.collectionVariables.set('imageResourceId', String(body.id)); }
pm.test('Image upload returns HTTP 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

if (pm.response.code === 200) { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.test('Upload reports PNG, positive size and SHA-256', function () { pm.expect(body.contentType).to.eql('image/png'); pm.expect(body.sizeBytes).to.be.above(0); pm.expect(body.sha256).to.match(/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/); }); pm.test('Upload identifies the Resource', function () { pm.expect(String(body.resourceId)).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('imageResourceId')); }); }
pm.test('Image retrieval returns HTTP 200 and PNG media type', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('Content-Type')).to.include('image/png'); });

pm.test('Image response disables caching and MIME sniffing', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('Cache-Control')).to.include('no-store'); pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('X-Content-Type-Options')).to.eql('nosniff'); });
pm.test('Image response has a nonzero Content-Length', function () { pm.expect(Number(pm.response.headers.get('Content-Length'))).to.be.above(0); });
pm.test('The zero-stock unreferenced fixture was deleted with HTTP 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
